corePassives.description:
Spectate: Within 3s after Yachiru releases her technique or successfully counters, switch her to the backline to have her Spectate. On-field characters increase their ATK by 20%, while their basic and special attacks grant Ultimate Energy to Yachiru (once per second). Switching Yachiru back in will stop her from Spectating. ~~Inspiration~~ 
 When Yachiru's Ultimate Energy reaches 50% or 100%, all her teammates gain Inspiration, increasing their Slash DMG by 10% for 6s. ~~Exclusive Seat~~ 
 When Kenpachi Zaraki is in the team, the bonuses from Spectate and Inspiration on him are increased by 1.5 times.
corePassives.name: Sideline Cheer

corePassives.description: If other characters already have Inspiration when Yachiru releases her Ultimate, its duration resets and Slash DMG increases by 10% for 15s.
corePassives.name: Exhilaration

corePassives.description: The duration of Inspiration increases by 4s when granted to deployed Slash characters.
corePassives.name: Absolute Focus

skills.description: Yachiru freely wields her Zanpakuto, striking the enemy up to 3 times for 73.5% total DMG. If switched out within 3s of her basic attack's final strike, she will immediately Spectate.
skills.name: Leave the Tough One to Me

skills.description: Yachiru launches the enemy into mid-air dealing DMG equal to 352.75% of ATK. If switched out within the next 3s, she will immediately Spectate.
skills.name: Time to Spectate

skills.description: Yachiru takes things seriously for once and unleashes all her Spiritual Power, dealing DMG equal to 517.5% of ATK to all nearby enemies. She also grants Inspiration to all teammates, increasing their Slash DMG by 10% for 6s. If switched out within the next 3s, she will immediately Spectate.
skills.name: Yachiru is Angry!

skills.description: Yachiru hurls her Zanpakuto at the enemy, dealing DMG equal to 467.87% of ATK. If switched out within the next 3s, she will immediately Spectate for 18s.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Yachiru gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
